Noah G.: Hi team — noticed the corp card was charged twice for hotel wifi on my recent stay (same merchant, two txn lines). One is $16.00 (card) and I paid a duplicate $16.00 on my personal card at checkout because the in-room portal failed. I uploaded both receipts. Can finance either reverse the duplicate on the corp ledger or reimburse me for the personal payment?
Maya (Finance): Thanks @Noah. Upload links? Also need the hotel folio showing both line items or a refund/credit note. If you paid the duplicate on your personal card, easiest path is to submit an expense for the $16 personal reimbursement and attach both the hotel folio and your personal card receipt. We'll mark the corp-card txn as passenger-dupe and reconcile.
Noah G.: Files: hotel_folio.pdf -> https://redwood-files/receipts/hotel_folio_1759001234.pdf ; personal_card_receipt.jpg -> https://redwood-files/receipts/personal_wifi_1759001234.jpg
expense-bot: To submit a duplicate-charge reimbursement: ```/expenses submit
amount: 16.00 USD
category: travel - incidentals
attach: hotel_folio.pdf, personal_card_receipt.jpg
notes: "Duplicate wifi charge - corp card & personal card both billed"```
Maya (Finance): Policy note: we reimburse genuine duplicate charges. If the merchant issues a refund to the corporate card before reconciliation, we will net it automatically and you won't need to submit. Since both charges posted, submit the personal reimbursement and we'll reconcile the corp txn as a matched duplicate. Also include any FX amounts if the bank converted differently.
Noah G.: The corp card posted $16.00 USD and my personal card shows $16.35 (fx+bank). Do you need the bank conversion proof?
Maya (Finance): Yes please include the card statement screenshot showing the $16.35. Finance will reimburse the USD amount you paid ($16.35). For small bank fees under $5 we typically absorb them, but we'll reimburse the full posted amount in this case.
Erin L.: Approved — please proceed with submission.
corp-card-bot: Duplicate transaction detected. Status: matched-possible-duplicate -> /expenses view 1759001234
Noah G.: Submitted and tagged @Maya and @Erin. Thanks!
Maya (Finance): Received. I'll process the reimbursement to your payroll next cycle and mark the corporate ledger to zero the duplicated wifi charge. Closing when posted. :white_check_mark:
